scope: UE1 source-only native archive cursor versus game-aware source provenance validation separation. Follow-on evidence for existing ue1-tables operation, not new tests/contracts or universal UE1 native loader certification.

native_authority.method: FArchive& operator<<(FArchive&, FObjectExport&) compiled x86 RVA 0x5da20
native_authority.rule: Read ClassIndex and SuperIndex as compact indices, PackageIndex as fixed signed int32, ObjectName FName, ObjectFlags uint32; only when ObjectFlags has 0x100 and archive licensee>=227 consume fixed signed int32 ArchetypeIndex; then compact SerialSize and optional compact SerialOffset on nonzero size.
native_authority.native_source_lic_before_227: Compiled code clears RF_HasArchtype in loaded in-memory ObjectFlags; UnrealDB deliberately retains serialized raw ObjectFlags for file metadata and does not emulate runtime object mutation.
native_authority.important_distinction: The compiled 227k serializer DOES NOT probe alternative layouts or reject ambiguity; these checks are UnrealDB source-provenance policy.

game_source_selector.scope: Only source-selected Unreal Gold; UT99 and UE2 retain their readers. Native reader accepts explicit archive layout without inferring writer. Selector probes alternate layout only if conditional field was observed, rejects dual-valid ambiguity and alternate-only unknown provenance, and records a structural verification marker in the selected original UE1 reader. No fallback serializer is used for publication.
game_source_selector.snapshot_fail_closed: UE1 UEDB5 v3 writer rejects any raw native Unreal export flagged with RF_HasArchtype under >=227 if no independent source-validation marker exists; no silent omission of archetype.

verified.positive: Native parser valid without provenance assertion; separate selector validates variant and marks it; UEDB5 v3 metadata writes and reads same archetype index.
negative: Direct native reader cannot generate UEDB5 v1 from an unverified archetype-flagged archive.
Both structurally valid layouts rejected by separate source selector; raw parser alone does not perform ambiguity check.
UT99 v69/licensee227 flag-shaped bytes parsed as UT99 no-extension layout; Unreal-selected alternative-only archive rejected as unsupported/unverified.
Below-licensee227 archive does not consume conditional signed-int32 field.
Existing Unreal v61 source-selected and UT99 v432 package snapshots unaffected.
verified.original_regression: Four SHA-identity-matched original file and game-specific UEDB5 snapshot fixtures: Unreal v61, UT99 v432, UT99 469f, UE2 runtime v126 all exact 4/4 PASS.
verified.previous_boundary_regression: Unreal v61 exact63-byte name without terminator and UT99 v61 terminator cases both PASS.

production_user_provided_diagnostic_2026.interpretation: No UEDB5 regeneration or rescan required for those 262 verified original files.

remaining_scope_limitations: Individual 227i builds with flagged exports have not been proven equivalent to 227k; selector fails closed on ambiguous/no-native evidence.
Diagnostic display of original raw serialized names/flags is not a UE1 package repacker.
Tests do not assert full original ULinkerLoad runtime imported-object behavior.
